description:
FOUND s506f (Opus, 2026-10-04).  `pcl -e` compiles a temp file `--as=-e` (task #2461), and $0, __FILE__
and die/warn locations say -e -- but the compiler's own drop / refusal announcement (and, per its comment,
the run-time die the PARSE ERROR emitters carry, which names the same site) still names the TEMP FILE.

REPRODUCER (618db500 and s506f):
  pcl -e 'print "x" if 1 ~~ 2'
  -> PCL: refused statement at /tmp/pcl_163798_D5Fl.pl line 1: print "x" if 1 ~~ 2 -- smart match ...
  (perl names the program -e)

CAUSE: Pl/Parser.pm `_drop_site` and `_announce_regex_gaps` take `$self->filename` (the v1 seam parser's
file), not the program's name; Parser2's Environment already carries it (`source_file` = `--as` NAME).
FIX: read the name from `$self->environment->source_file` at both sites (one helper).  The harness
wrapper (tools/pclperl-for-tests) rewrites the temp path in stderr, so this shows only under `pcl`.
subject: `pcl -e`: the compiler's drop/refusal announcement names the temp file (/tmp/pcl_NNN.pl), not -e (`--as` reaches $0/__FILE__ but not Pl/Parser.pm _drop_site)
